description:
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
The Sixth Doctor triggers, copying the Ugin's Nexus spell, with the copy being nonlegendary.
Resolve both Ugin's Nexus spells.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Ugin's Nexus token, adding {C}{C}.
The Ugin's Nexus token is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning the nontoken Ugin's Nexus to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
